name: Give Food
tagline: UK charity using data to highlight and alleviate local food insecurity
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on volunteer contributions for data collection and curation
Dependency on food bank participation for data accuracy
news_articles: Guardian: Food banks map reveals extent of UK hunger crisis
BBC News: Charity maps UK food bank locations
Reuters: Data platform highlights food insecurity across Britain
academic_citations: Loopstra, R., & Tarasuk, V. (2015). Food bank usage is a poor indicator of food insecurity: insights from Canada. International Journal of Food Security

policy_outcomes.description: Platform enables citizens to write to MPs regarding food insecurity

outcome_methodology: Platform tracks user engagement metrics and MP correspondence generated through the platform
documented_limitations: Data coverage varies by region; some areas have incomplete food bank listings
Relies on self-reported data from food banks and donors
Does not capture informal food assistance networks
jurisdictional_scope: United Kingdom (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland)
failure_modes: Data quality issues when food banks do not update their information regularly
Geographic gaps in coverage in rural areas
curation_criteria: Food banks must be registered charities or recognized community organizations; data verified through direct contact and public records
contributor_governance: Community-driven contributions with moderation by core team; open to volunteers for data collection and verification
disparity_tracking: Platform tracks food insecurity by geographic location and identifies areas with highest need
community_ownership: Community-driven data collection model with food banks and local organizations as primary data contributors
government_partnerships: Partnerships with local councils for data sharing and advocacy
